text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 839 College Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application for the proposed boulevard café located at 839 College Street, with the following conditions: a. the application be approved without a fencing requirement unless required by the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario; and b. the patio application be reviewed in 2019.
